what: Same international seller reports adopting Zonos for direct billing of duties and taxes and creating dozens of duplicate shipping profiles within Etsy to reflect estimated tariff costs as a workaround for US tariff compliance.
verbatim_snippet: "I got set up with Zonos (for direct billing of duties and taxes) and verified and integrated with Canada Post for shipping on their platform. I created dozens of duplicate shipping profiles within Etsy to reflect estimated tariff costs based on various items with different Country of Origin (COO)"
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. Same poster as F-P04; separate passage describing the workaround (vs. the problem in F-P04). External tools: Zonos (duties/taxes billing), Canada Post integration. Canada-based vintage seller. Workaround involved creating "dozens" of duplicate shipping profiles for different Country of Origin values.
